content.sub1:
5am.Earth makes trusted agricultural information from the ground easier and more affordable to access.
Helping organizations uncover insights and unlock new business opportunities.

content.h2: Start with people already in the field.
content.intro: The Syngenta Foundation Agri-Entrepreneur program already connects local entrepreneurs with farmers across India. 5am.earth is building the verification layer on that working network.
content.stat1l: smallholder farmers connected through the program
content.stat2l: trained Agri-Entrepreneurs in the established network
content.sourceNote: Source: Earth Observation and Blockchain Integration research report. Network figures refer to the Syngenta Foundation Agri-Entrepreneur program in India.
content.pilotH3: The next step is measured, not assumed.

content.h2: A claim is useful only if others can verify it.
content.lede: Local field knowledge establishes what happened. Satellite evidence verifies the place and its history.  Consent determines where the record can go next.

content.h2: Start with the value you need.
content.intro: The same farmer is verified repeatedly — by banks, buyers, insurers, and governments — each paying the full cost, creating another isolated record that no one else can use. This makes every service built on top prohibitively expensive, locking smallholder farmers out of finance, markets, and support.

content.h2: The record stays useful after the first check.
content.lede: 5am.earth solution drives down the cost of trusted field information,  the cost of every service built on it — loans, insurance, traceability, government programmes.
content.o3: Stronger visibility for lenders and buyers

content.body: The first use case combines local field records with satellite evidence. Identities and information from multiple sources are anchored on the Cardano blockchain, so any record can be independently verified by anyone, without exposing a farmer’s personal data.
content.m3b: Lower risk and expand financial inclusion

content.h2: World class partners are already engaged.
content.bullets:
Help us build the world’s leading farmer community, powered by trusted information.”

content.h1: One field record. Four checks before it travels.
content.body: 5am.earth connects local evidence with satellite checks, consent and a traceable record of origin.

content.s1b: An Agri-Entrepreneur records the farmer, field and activity where the work happens.
content.s2b: Satellite imagery checks field boundaries against current signals and land history.
content.s3b: Identity and consent are attached to the evidence. Its source can now be traced.
content.s4b: The farmer can permit the same record to support another service or decision.

content.body: How field evidence, Earth observation, and secure provenance become practical infrastructure for agricultural services.

content.intro: A collaboration designed around the Syngenta Foundation Agri-Entrepreneur program and its existing farmer relationships.
content.stat3l: farmers in the planned initial deployment
content.s1b: Farmer and field evidence is repeatedly collected, difficult to reuse, and often disconnected from financial and market services.
content.s2b: Agri-Entrepreneurs capture field information. Satellite data validates boundaries and land signals. Cardano infrastructure records verifiable provenance.
content.s3b: Blockchain-verified land border records and historical sustainability ratings create reusable evidence for services and decisions.
content.s4b: Lower risk for financial partners, better service delivery, and new pathways to finance, insurance, markets, and advisory support.
content.quote: Verified once. Reused across the next service, decision, and opportunity.

content.eyebrow: Develop a case study with us
